simple: A local agent on the application server that delivers passwords from the Idira Privileged Access Manager vault to commercial software, scripts, databases, RPA robots and mainframes (formerly CyberArk AIM, Application Identity Manager). Before handing over a password, it checks that the request really comes from an allowed application — by path, hash, OS user, address or certificate. Passwords are no longer hardcoded in code and configuration and are rotated by policy without downtime; the agent cache keeps things running even if the vault is unreachable. Every password retrieval is audited. Windows, Linux, AIX, z/OS; SDKs and a CLI are available for custom scripts. Licensed per server (per LPAR for z/OS).
